verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
LABA-Omusumba-omulungi
Bw'ayita-endiga ze:
Ennafu azisitula,
Ento azirisa.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Azitwala ku mabbali
-Ag'amazzi g'obulamu-;
Era n'awali omuddo
-Omulungi omuto.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Bwe zikyama nga zireka
Ekkubo lye-effunda;
-Omusumba oyo-omwesigwa
Azigoberera.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Bwe tutyo ffe tutambule,
Tugende n'essanyu;
Ye ng'atukuuma bulijjo
Mu kkubo lye-eddungi.
